briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google escalate multi-agent AGI race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push scaling limits amid regulatory scrutiny. Multi-agent systems show rapid capability gains while security gaps widen. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4-preview with 40% gains on agentic tasks. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek R2 and xAI Grok-3 compete on cost-efficiency. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: EU AI Act enforcement begins with fines for high-risk systems. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, CAN bus, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to Microsoft and Google. TSMC announces 1.4nm AI chip capacity ramp for 2027. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI data centers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
